```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

# Outcome variable
outcome <- "IRPYUD5MRJ"

# Candidate predictors
predictors <- c(
  "CATAG3",
  "IRSEX",
  "NEWRACE2",
  "IRMARIT",
  "INCOME",
  "POVERTY3",
  "IREDUHIGHST2",
  "IRWRKSTAT",
  "GOVTPROG",
  "IRINSUR4",
  "HEALTH",
  "COUTYP4",
  "ALCMON",
  "IRALCBNG30D",
  "CIGMON",
  "DIFGETMRJ",
  "RSKMRJWK",
  "IRAMDEYR",
  "IRPYUD5ALC",
  "YEAR"
)

# Check variable availability
required_vars <- c(outcome, predictors)

missing_vars <- setdiff(
  required_vars,
  names(NSDUH_2021_2024)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

  "CIGMON",
  "IRALCBNG30D",
  "DIFGETMRJ",
  "RSKMRJWK",
  "YEAR",
  "IRAMDEYR",
  "YMDEYR"
)

# Check missing variable names
setdiff(
  c(outcome, predictors),
  names(NSDUH_2021_2024)
)

# Create updated analysis dataset
cud_data <- NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  select(any_of(c(outcome, predictors)))

# Verify dimensions
dim(cud_data)

# View first six rows
head(cud_data)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# All candidate predictors from the analysis plan
candidate_predictors <- c(
  "CATAG6", "IRSEX", "NEWRACE2",
  "IRMARIT", "EDUHIGHCAT",
  "IRWRKSTAT", "INCOME",
  "POVERTY3", "GOVTPROG",
  "IRINSUR4", "HEALTH",
  "COUTYP4", "YEAR",
  "SPDPSTYR", "ALCYR",
  "IRPYUD5ALC", "CIGYR",
  "COCYR", "ILLYR",
  "IRMJFY", "IRMJAGE",
  "DIFOBTMRJ"
)

# Identify variables missing from the dataset
setdiff(
  candidate_predictors,
  names(NSDUH_2021_2024)
)

# Calculate ordinary missing-value percentages
available <- intersect(
  candidate_predictors,
  names(NSDUH_2021_2024)
)

missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = available,
  Missing_Percent = round(
    sapply(
      NSDUH_2021_2024[available],
      function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100
    ),
    2
  )
)

missing_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing_Percent))

```

```{r}
NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  group_by(CATAG6) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Missing = sum(is.na(SPDPSTYR)),
    Missing_Percent = round(
      mean(is.na(SPDPSTYR)) * 100, 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


```{r}

NSDUH_2021_2024 <- NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    MDE_PY = case_when(
      CATAG6 == 1 & YMDEYR == 1 ~ 1,
      CATAG6 == 1 & YMDEYR == 2 ~ 0,
      CATAG6 != 1 & IRAMDEYR == 1 ~ 1,
      CATAG6 != 1 & IRAMDEYR == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Check distribution and missingness
table(NSDUH_2021_2024$MDE_PY, useNA = "ifany")

# Check missingness by age group
NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  group_by(CATAG6) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Missing = sum(is.na(MDE_PY)),
    Missing_Percent = round(
      mean(is.na(MDE_PY)) * 100, 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


```{r}

# Remove adult-only psychological distress variable
candidate_predictors <- setdiff(
  candidate_predictors,
  "SPDPSTYR"
)

# Add combined depression variable
candidate_predictors <- unique(
  c(candidate_predictors, "MDE_PY")
)

# Verify updated predictors
candidate_predictors

```


# we removed a variable missing ages 12 to 17 respondents and combined with a similar variable indicative of depression to fill in that gap. 


```{r}

NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  filter(!is.na(MDE_PY)) %>%
  group_by(MDE_PY) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    CUD_Cases = sum(IRPYUD5MRJ == 1),
    CUD_Percent = round(
      mean(IRPYUD5MRJ == 1) * 100,
      2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```
#Initial exploratory analysis revealed an association between past-year major depressive episode (MDE) and cannabis use disorder (CUD). Among respondents with past-year MDE, 19.45% had CUD, compared with 6.95% of respondents without MDE. This suggests that depression may be an important predictor of CUD and warrants further investigation through classification models.





```{r}

library(ggplot2)

mde_cud <- NSDUH_2021_2024 %>%
  filter(!is.na(MDE_PY)) %>%
  group_by(MDE_PY) %>%
  summarise(
    CUD_Percent = mean(IRPYUD5MRJ == 1) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MDE_Status = ifelse(
      MDE_PY == 1, "Past-Year MDE", "No MDE"
    )
  )

ggplot(mde_cud,
       aes(x = MDE_Status, y = CUD_Percent,
           fill = MDE_Status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(CUD_Percent, 2), "%")),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cannabis Use Disorder by Depression Status",
    x = "Past-Year Major Depressive Episode",
    y = "Respondents with CUD (%)"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 25) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

cud_clean <- cud_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Outcome as a classification factor
    CUD = factor(
      IRPYUD5MRJ,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),

    # Nonresponses for overall health
    HEALTH = ifelse(
      HEALTH %in% c(94, 97),
      NA_real_,
      HEALTH
    ),

    # Marital status: 99 is an age-related skip
    IRMARIT = factor(
      IRMARIT,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Married",
        "Widowed",
        "Divorced/Separated",
        "Never Married",
        "Not Applicable"
      )
    ),

    # Employment: 99 is an age-related skip
    IRWRKSTAT = factor(
      IRWRKSTAT,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 99),
      labels = c(
        "Full Time",
        "Part Time",
        "Unemployed",
        "Other",
        "Not Applicable"
      )
    ),

    # Education
    EDUHIGHCAT = factor(EDUHIGHCAT),

    # Income
    INCOME = factor(INCOME),

    # Insurance status
    IRINSUR4 = factor(IRINSUR4),

    # Age categories
    CATAG6 = factor(CATAG6)
  )

# Confirm outcome distribution
table(cud_clean$CUD)

# Check cleaned health variable
table(cud_clean$HEALTH, useNA = "ifany")

```

```{r}

# Chi-square tests for categorical predictors

variables <- c(
  "CATAG6",
  "MDE_PY",
  "IRPYUD5ALC",
  "INCOME",
  "POVERTY3"
)

chi_results <- lapply(variables, function(v) {

  tab <- table(cud_clean[[v]], cud_clean$CUD)

  test <- chisq.test(tab)

  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    Chi_Square = round(as.numeric(test$statistic), 2),
    P_Value = test$p.value
  )
})

chi_results <- do.call(rbind, chi_results)

print(chi_results)

```
```{r}

# Calculate Cramer's V for each predictor

cramers_results <- lapply(variables, function(v) {

  tab <- table(cud_clean[[v]], cud_clean$CUD)

  n <- sum(tab)
  chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab)$statistic)

  cramers_v <- sqrt(
    as.numeric(chi) /
      (n * (min(dim(tab)) - 1))
  )

  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    Cramers_V = round(cramers_v, 4)
  )
})

cramers_results <- do.call(rbind, cramers_results)

print(cramers_results)

```

```{r}


# Select categorical predictors for comparison
predictors <- c(
  "CATAG6",
  "IRSEX",
  "NEWRACE2",
  "IRMARIT",
  "EDUHIGHCAT",
  "IRWRKSTAT",
  "INCOME",
  "POVERTY3",
  "GOVTPROG",
  "HEALTH",
  "IRINSUR4",
  "COUTYP4",
  "MDE_PY",
  "ALCYR",
  "IRPYUD5ALC",
  "CIGYR",
  "COCYR"
)

# Calculate chi-square and Cramer's V
association_results <- lapply(predictors, function(v) {

  tab <- table(cud_clean[[v]], cud_clean$CUD)

  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))

  n <- sum(tab)

  cramers_v <- sqrt(
    as.numeric(test$statistic) /
      (n * (min(dim(tab)) - 1))
  )

  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    Chi_Square = round(as.numeric(test$statistic), 2),
    P_Value = test$p.value,
    Cramers_V = round(cramers_v, 4)
  )
})

association_results <- bind_rows(association_results) %>%
  arrange(desc(Cramers_V))

print(association_results)

```
```{r}

ggplot(
  association_results,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Variable, Cramers_V),
    y = Cramers_V
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Association Strength Between Predictors and CUD",
    subtitle = "Cramer's V - NSDUH 2021-2024",
    x = "Predictor Variable",
    y = "Cramer's V"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
